_comment: Tier-2 for skfem heat#: two LLM-trap claims surfaced via mcp__open-fem-agent__prepare_simulation. (a) ib.get_dofs() returns DofsView which is NOT subscriptable by string — dv['left'] raises TypeError 'object is not subscriptable'. Correct: ib.get_dofs('left'). (b) condense(K, f, x=..., D=D)'s x must be a FULL-size vector (length=ib.N), not just constrained values; passing a short array raises IndexError 'out of bounds'. Both claims were buried in the heat Template comment but absent from the pitfalls list. Verified empirically 2026-06-01 (skfem 12.0.1). MUTATION CONTROL (re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 applies both documented fixes at their pathology sites -- the DofsView probe becomes the positional ib.get_dofs('left') instead of dv['left'], and the condense probe is handed a full-size x (length ib.N) instead of the short constrained-values array. Re-verified by execution 2026-08-06 on skfem 12.0.1: the unmutated run matches all 6 expect_in_output strings; T2_MUTATE=1 removes 'dofsview_subscript_raises_typeerror=True', 'dofsview_msg_has_not_subscriptable=True', 'condense_short_x_raises_indexerror=True' and 'condense_short_msg_has_out_of_bounds=True' so the fixture goes red. Re-run: T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py
